modules.module_title: Interpret the job cards and manage the workday

pcs.pc_description: interpret and plan out the work in accordance with the job cards received from the supervisor
prepare a list of all the necessary materials, tools, and equipment required for the various job work
ensure coordination with the various departments for material movement at various intervals
ensure daily filling and timely submission of job cards to the supervisor

modules.module_title: Prepare the worksite for recce and take measurements

pcs.pc_description: update the supervisor for any shortage or requirement of the tools and equipment
assist in interpreting the site layout in order to perform the physical survey of the worksite during recce
examine the recce site for any possible health and safety hazards and ensure it is prepared for marking and measurement purpose
assist in marking the worksite as per layout plan and take measurements
prepare the measurement sheet and handover to supervisor in-time
interpret the material loading/ unloading/ handling instruction sheet
assist in preparing the execution plan with supervisor as per the instruction sheet
assist in performing a visual quality check of handling equipment
ensure proper arrangement of the handling equipment for loading and unloading of the materials at the specified location
assist in the Quality Checking (QC) process of the materials before loading and unloading

modules.module_title: Segregate and store the materials, tools, and equipment

pcs.pc_description: ensure the use of appropriate containers to store or carry rivets, bolts, drift pins, etc.
ensure that all the materials and equipment are stacked properly for easy identification and traceability
ensure proper disposal of combustible waste products at the end of each work day
maintain proper records of materials, tools, and equipment for each workday and update the supervisor

modules.module_title: Prepare the worksite for fabrication, assembly, and installation purposes

pcs.pc_description: organize all the necessary tools, materials, and equipment required for the specified operations
ensure the work area is cleaned for hazard- free operations and appropriate floor and machine guards are in place
ensure power sockets are functional as per the required job work
set the work bench, tools, and machines as per the required job work
ensure the usage of proper methods for cleaning and maintenance of the tools and equipment at regular intervals

modules.module_title: Interpret and select resources as per instructions

pcs.pc_description: interpret the job card and plan out the workday in consultation with the supervisor
interpret the CAD-based or conventionally prepared drawings and specifications
select the correct materials to comply with drawings and specifications

modules.module_title: Set out, measure, and mark the timber and timber- based materials

pcs.pc_description: identify the timber and timber-based materials for appropriate operations
assist in identifying different members of the products as per the given specifications
assist in preparing the part list of product with the supervisor
use the suitable tool for marking on the wood as per the specified dimensions
assist in collecting information related to marking and measuring of materials using appropriate means or techniques
use appropriate calculations and formulae to confirm the accuracy

modules.module_title: Form joints and prepare members of the product for assembly

pcs.pc_description: cut the joints safely and accurately using hand and power tools
use the appropriate planing and shaping tools to prepare the members of the product as per specifications
smoothen out the wooden surface using suitable sanding papers and tools
conduct a visual check for any errors or damages in the wood or a given part
check the overall accuracy and quality in terms of measurements, fitting of assembled parts, rigidity, steadiness, leveling, etc.
rectify if any defects are found in any members of the product
clean the parts of the product for the assembly operation
assist in preparing the production status update report

modules.module_title: Assist in assembling the various members of the product

pcs.pc_description: interpret the assembly drawings and instructions of the product
measure the various components and segregate them for the pre-assembly marking operation
select and use the specified fasteners wherever required
assist in assembling and erecting structures accurately without damage to components
assist in knocking down the existing cabinets, fixtures, and other fittings on the worksite as per the directions from supervisor

modules.module_title: Assist in finishing the surface of the product

pcs.pc_description: attach members neatly using appropriate fasteners or/ add adhesives as applicable
prepare accurate joints and intersections with no gaps
use the appropriate wood fillers and sanding papers to finish the product to a specified standard as per the supervisor’s instruction

modules.module_title: Assist in installation of the product and its handover

pcs.pc_description: identify slots for placing/ installing each furniture part as per design
undertake requisite cut-outs for electrical outlets, plumbing points, and other arrangements
assist in installation and fastening of furniture components to the surface/ wall using appropriate adhesives/ hardware, etc.
assist in installation of fittings (like locks, latch etc.), decorative mouldings/ finish accessories (crown moulding, decorative panels etc.)
ensure that the installed product is cleaned thoroughly before handover
undertake checks at regular intervals during installation to avoid any defects/ error detection at later stage

pcs.pc_description: ensure adequate stock of cleaning materials and consumables
identify and report poor organizational practices with respect to hygiene, food handling, cleaning
ensure that the trash cans or waste collection points are cleared every day

use appropriate personal protective equipment compatible with the work and compliant to relevant Occupational Health and Safety (OHS) guidelines: masks, safety glasses, head protection, ear muffs, safety footwear, gloves, aprons, etc.
use emergency equipment in accordance with manufacturers' specifications as per requirement
follow the dress code of the worksite
wash hands regularly using suggested material such as soap, one-use disposable tissue, warm water, etc.

modules.module_title: Follow precautionary measures to avoid work hazards

pcs.pc_description: follow the displayed safety signs at the worksite
undertake the safety measures and checks while handling any electrically powered tools, and equipment, etc.
ensure the usage of harmful chemicals inside work area as per the specified guidelines only
ensure safe handling and disposal of waste and debris
undertake correct ways while lifting or movement of the heavy material from one place to another

modules.module_title: Ensure material conservation and optimization of resources

pcs.pc_description: ensure optimal material utilization in the specific processes
implement the suggested ways to conserve and re-use water
ensure to keep the electrical appliances in OFF position when not in use
carry out routine cleaning of tools, machines, and equipment as per instruction
